common_limitations: Status discipline (m01-plan E15): rows marked verified mean the indexed tests ran and passed on that platform in this run at ca21d621; this is not an independent review of the units.

Linux and Windows binaries were cross-built on the macOS host with zig (glibc floor 2.31 / x86_64-windows-gnu) and executed natively on the hosts; proptest regression files (resolved at compile-time source paths) were not present on the remote hosts, so persisted regression seeds replayed only on macOS; default fixed seeds ran everywhere.

The second owner Linux host (<second linux host>) was not run: the owner's Tailscale SSH policy refuses the configured user (ADR-0006 §13.6 item 9). Linux x86-64 evidence comes from one host (linux-a).
contracts (platform-neutral schema/golden-file checks) and integration_runtime::config_schema_export_matches_checked_in_file read repository files at compile-time paths and ran on macOS only.

e2e_cli_m01 pseudo-terminal cases are cfg(unix) (script(1)) and ran on macOS and Linux only; e2e_cli_m01::service_stop_falls_back_to_a_signal_when_the_control_endpoint_is_unusable is Unix-only by design (platform_only macOS/Linux).

Every fake effect, clock and store in these tests is a disposable fixture (FakeCredentialAdapter, VirtualClock/ScriptedTimeSync, in-memory or temp-dir SQLite, owner-only sockets/pipes in temp dirs); no provider, network service or real key was used.

A06.summary: Duplicate concurrent requests coalesce to one operation and one fake effect; dropped caller and same-key retry converge; altered parameters conflict; purged keys are REQUEST_EXPIRED in the marker window; crashes before the effect, after the effect before the receipt, and after the receipt reconcile without a second effect, in-process (model_operations, new adapter over the same ledger) and process-crash (u10_process_crash_*: core in a child process killed by exact handle; e2e_cli_m01 service killed by exact PID on macOS); the resolved deadline never restarts.
limitations: The CLI process-crash variants (e2e_cli_m01 a06_* incl. the caller-killed case of gap G13) ran natively on macOS, Linux (linux-a) and Windows 11 at ca21d621.

In-process restarts are labelled in-process in the case index and do not close the process-crash claim; the process-crash rows are u10_process_crash_*, integration_store crash children and e2e_cli_m01 a06_* (all on macOS, Linux and Windows).

A07.summary: Revoke during a slow prepare denies child and parent and ignores the late Prepared; pending approvals cannot complete after a revoke; publish re-runs the production issuance::check and voids after revoke, cutoff, policy-revision change, budget expiry and TIME_UNCERTAIN; reserve refuses on the same predicates; a reservation found after restart stays counted and is never published; remote_pending and residual are truthful. Two ADR-0006 §13.5 rulings fail (gap cases). Gap fixes (M01-wave2-gapfix): an unrelated revoke re-validates healthy grants silently (ADR-0006 §13.5 ruling 2; the stale decision record is DECISION_STALE, the waiting operation stays waiting and gets a fresh decision_ref) while an ancestor revoke fails the chain; a delegated child holds a reference on its parent (ruling 1); permitted extensions come from the grant snapshot (ruling 3); every applicable policy's cutoff bounds the grant (G08); reserve/publish interleavings include wall-deadline passage and assert every void reason (G12).
limitations: Time uncertainty at delivery to the receiving signer is M03 (not modelled).
R-AU-04/R-SE-07 (A07 managed issuance, M03) are not claimed.

Re-validation readings chosen fail closed and escalated (M01-wave2-gapfix): a pause or cutoff touching the chain fails it; StandingPolicy/Delegation grants need Allowed on re-resolution, OwnerDecision grants need only not-denied; publish voids (StaleGeneration) when the generation moved since its reservation even for an unrelated change.

A08.summary: Time model and TimeGate over the store: sleep across expiry, wall running, backward/forward jumps, stuck wall across same-boot restart never extends the budget, reboot below the mark refused even synchronized, unsynchronized reboot refused, synchronized reboot keeps the persisted bound, attended confirmation resolves uncertainty without moving deadlines, N01 shorten counterexample, N05 reboot slightly below mark; runtime scheduler expires at the persisted bound and continuous budget end; time guard refuses rollback and unsynchronized reboot with TIME_UNCERTAIN; platform clock probes on each host.
limitations: Native sleep/logout/reboot behaviour is M04 (blocked row).
SystemTimeSync reports Unknown on every platform in M01 (fail-closed default).

A19.summary: Success, pending approval with decision_ref (attended and unattended), unattended decide refused, stale and expired decisions, pending-approval deadline expiry, timeout is not cancel, explicit cancel reports possible effect, OutcomeUnknown never reported as no effect, event dedup, foreign/expired cursors resync with a usable snapshot cursor, mutation during snapshot and publish during replay-to-live delivered once, lag past 256 yields one ResyncRequired, backpressure; IPC session bounds; CLI exit classes 0-7 and owner prompt on a pseudo-terminal (macOS).
limitations: e2e_cli_m01 non-pseudo-terminal cases (incl. inspect --preview and --require-capability, gap G17, and every exit class 0-7) ran on macOS, Linux and Windows; the pseudo-terminal cases are cfg(unix) and ran on macOS and Linux only, so the Windows row is in_progress (see its incomplete_run and harness_gap).

A29.summary: Cross-owner request IDs are distinct keys; another principal's binding is NOT_FOUND/NotOwner; request fields never widen the resolved scope; metadata ignored; attendance only via Attend on an interactive session; config refuses trusted and authority keys at any depth without echo; bounded IPC and signing framers survive adversarial streams; forged peers and foreign/permissive sockets refused; Windows pipe owner/SID checks on the owner's Windows PC.
limitations: Cross-user Windows pipe refusal is blocked on the disposable second Windows account.
Malformed manifests and repository-instruction injection (A29 M05+ scope) are not M01 claims.

A17-local.summary: Single instance (second start AlreadyRunning, stale instance.json ignored, eight concurrent clients start one child), restart recovery reconciles Attempted receipts without preparing again, pause and environment identity survive in-process and process-crash restarts, store crash children at every transaction and migration point reopen to exactly the committed state, resource CAS never lets a stale writer win, repeated adapter unavailability gives one call per request and a stable code with no retry storm. N06 (a)/(b) now run through the production supervisor cleanup executor (Supervisor::cleanup_pass, ResourceCleaner port, CleanupHook at the deletion boundary): the replacement N+1 created between the decision and the delete survives and N is gone; Unavailable is retried only by that executor with Backoff spacing (0.5 s doubling), capped at 8 attempts, then SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, with no operation, decision or prompt (in-process, fake cleaner).
limitations: Helper-process crashes and duplicate observers (A17 M02+) are not M01 claims.

N06 executor cases are in-process with a fake ResourceCleaner (M01 ships no production cleaner; M02 adapters add them); a failed operation prepare is still reported once with a stable code and not retried automatically (u10_a17_repeated_unavailable_*: the operations path, a different reading, indexed but not counted toward N06).

Windows: service stop over the named pipe, eight concurrent clients starting one runtime and the a06 kill/restart cases ran natively (e2e_cli_m01); integration_runtime::instance_stale_records_are_ignored is cfg(unix) with no Windows equivalent (G09 remainder), so the Windows row is in_progress, not blocked.
